heading: Join algorithm
text:
### Join algorithm [IRET.7.7]

**On right-activation (new fact added to alpha memory):**

1. Iterate the beta node's left memory.
2. For each token in left memory: build the candidate
   extended token (left token + new fact).
3. Evaluate all join tests. If all pass: propagate the
   extended token to all beta children and terminal
   children.

**On left-activation (new token arrives from left parent):**

1. Iterate the beta node's right alpha memory.
2. For each fact in the alpha memory: build the candidate
   extended token (left token + fact).
3. Evaluate all join tests. If all pass: propagate.

**On right-retraction (fact removed from alpha memory):**

1. Iterate left memory; find all tokens whose facts[k]
   (for the relevant pattern index k) equals the
   retracted fact.
2. For each such token: send a retraction downstream.

No join test is evaluated: a retraction ends these pairs, and a pair it ends
records no fault ([LERR.1.4.12]).

**On left-retraction (token removed from left parent):**

1. For each extended token that was built from this token:
   send retraction downstream.

idris.name: iret_7_7__activate_chain
idris.note: One chain's response to a fact admitted to an alpha.

idris.name: iret_7_7__extend_front
idris.note: Left-activation's joins: every token of the front against the right memory.

idris.name: iret_7_7__next
idris.note: The same, read off the node.

idris.name: iret_7_7__next_of
idris.note: What a node passes on from the tokens it receives, by the negative flag and the join tests: their joins with its right memory, or, for a NOT node, those the memory leaves unblocked, unextended [IRET.7.9.5].

idris.name: iret_7_7__retract_chain
idris.note: One chain's response to a fact removed from an alpha.

idris.name: iret_7_7__right_activate
idris.note: RIGHT-ACTIVATION of every node of a chain fed by the alpha, deepest first, for a fact just admitted: a positive node extends each left token the fact joins and sends the extensions down; a NOT node counts the fact against each left token it joins and retracts downstream the tokens it newly blocks [IRET.7.9.2]. Deepest first so that a token the shallower activation creates never meets its own fact twice: the reading the clause needs to produce each match once.

idris.name: iret_7_7__right_retract
idris.note: RIGHT-RETRACTION of every node fed by the alpha, deepest first, for a fact just removed: a positive node retracts downstream each extension it had built from the fact; a NOT node uncounts it and releases the tokens it no longer blocks [IRET.7.9.3].

idris.name: iret_7_7__store
idris.note: The join algorithm's memory step: arrivals are stored before they are joined.

idris.name: iret_7_7__view
idris.note: THE RECOMPUTE, node by node: the tokens each prefix of a chain should pass, from the nil token, over working memory alone. What the memories are proved to hold.

idris.name: iret_7_7__wave
idris.note: LEFT-ACTIVATION as a wave down the chain: each node stores the arrivals, joins them against its right memory, and the extended tokens flow on; what leaves the last node activates the terminal [IRET.8.1].

idris.name: iret_7_8__unwave
idris.note: LEFT-RETRACTION as a wave: each node drops the departing tokens and their counts; every extension built from them leaves too, or, for a NOT node, the tokens it had passed; what leaves the last node ends the activations.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__extend_lengths
idris.note: Extending a front of prefixes of one length gives prefixes one longer.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__view_from_front
idris.note: Every token the chain passes is a guarded, unblocked tuple of the positive kinds.

idris.name: iret_19_5__tick_chain_consistent
idris.note: A re-timed single positive node is consistent under its new test: its memory is what the clause's join gives at the new clock.

idris.name: iret_19_5__tick_chains_consistent
idris.note: Every chain, re-timed or not, is consistent after the re-time.

idris.name: Iret_7_9_1__clear
idris.note: The passage the four paths maintain, node by node.

idris.name: iret_7_7__through_clear
idris.note: What a chain passes came through it clear.

idris.name: iret_7_7__consistent_distinct
idris.note: A consistent chain's activations are distinct.

idris.name: iret_7_7__consistent_tuples
idris.note: Consistency survives any change to the activations' flags: it reads the tuples.

idris.name: iret_7_7__consistent_view
idris.note: Consistency read through the alpha view is the recompute: the terminal holds exactly what the chain passes from the front over working memory.

idris.name: iret_7_7__next_of_nil
idris.note: A node passes nothing on from nothing.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_5__recompute_after_history
idris.note: THE VIEW THEOREM, closed at the top: after any history from a loaded network -- every input pumped, in order [LFST.9.2.1] -- incremental propagation has left every alpha memory and every terminal exactly as the recompute over working memory would. Content only: the order theorem of [LDET.5.5] / [LDET.5.9] is the next increment.

idris.name: iret_7_7__consistent_through
idris.note: A consistent chain's terminal holds, as a set, what the chain passes from its front.

idris.name: iret_7_7__next_live
idris.note: What a node passes on from live tokens over a memory of live facts is live.

idris.name: iret_7_7__right_activate_ordered
idris.note: RIGHT-ACTIVATION KEEPS THE ORDER: the matches the fact completes are live and new to the terminal and take their timetags' places; the survivors keep theirs; what a NOT node newly blocks ends.

idris.name: iret_7_7__right_retract_ordered
idris.note: RIGHT-RETRACTION KEEPS THE ORDER under the working memory the retraction found: the matches the fact had completed end, and the matches a NOT node releases -- live, not built on the fact -- take the places their keys give them.

idris.name: iret_7_7__through
idris.note: What a chain passes from a front, node by node over the memories as they stand: the tokens left-activation delivers to the terminal.

idris.name: iret_7_7__through_disjoint
idris.note: Disjoint fronts pass through disjoint.

idris.name: iret_7_7__through_distinct
idris.note: A distinct front passes through distinct, over distinct memories.

idris.name: iret_7_7__through_live
idris.note: Live tokens pass through live, over memories of live facts.

idris.name: iret_7_7__wave_ordered
idris.note: LEFT-ACTIVATION KEEPS THE ORDER: the arrivals activate at their timetags' places.

idris.name: iret_7_7__wave_snd
idris.note: The wave's terminal is the activation of exactly what the chain passes from the arrivals.

idris.name: iret_7_7__extend_new_disjoint
idris.note: Extensions by a fact not in the memory are new.

idris.name: iret_7_7__extend_new_fact
idris.note: Joining against a memory grown by one fact: the old extensions, plus the left tokens the new fact joins, extended by it -- exactly what right-activation builds.

idris.name: iret_7_7__extend_remove
idris.note: A positive node's output after a right fact leaves: what it passed, less the extensions built from the fact -- exactly what right-retraction withdraws, with no facts[k] to search for.

idris.name: iret_7_7__extend_remove_bwd_at
idris.note: What was passed and not built from the leaving fact is still passed.

idris.name: iret_7_7__extend_remove_fwd
idris.note: What a node passes after a fact leaves was passed and was not built from it.

idris.name: iret_7_7__extend_remove_sub
idris.note: The extensions built from a fact of the memory were passed.

idris.name: iret_7_7__right_activate_consistent
idris.note: A FACT ENTERS ONE ALPHA MEMORY: every chain consistent with the old memories is, after right-activating its nodes fed by that alpha deepest first, consistent with the new ones. A positive node's extensions by the fact reach the terminal through the nodes below; a NOT node's newly blocked tokens are withdrawn from them. The clause's right-activation, and [IRET.19.1] step 7 read as right- rather than left-activation: the step feeds an alpha memory, which is a join's right input.

idris.name: iret_7_7__right_retract_consistent
idris.note: A FACT LEAVES ONE ALPHA MEMORY: every chain consistent with the old memories is, after right-retracting its nodes fed by that alpha deepest first, consistent with the new ones. A positive node's extensions by the fact leave the nodes below; a NOT node releases the tokens the fact alone was blocking. The clause's right-retraction, read as 'each left token that joins the retracted fact' since a left token has no facts[k].

idris.name: iret_19_5__retime_consistent
idris.note: THE TICK KEEPS THE VIEW: a single positive node consistent under the old test is consistent under the new one after the tick -- the terminal holds exactly the matches at the new clock, none twice. Re-evaluation on every tick misses nothing and leaves nothing stale.

idris.name: iret_7_7__right_activate_shape
idris.note: Right-activation keeps a chain's shape.

idris.name: iret_7_7__right_retract_shape
idris.note: Right-retraction keeps a chain's shape.

idris.name: iret_7_7__wave_shape
idris.note: Left-activation keeps a chain's shape.

idris.name: iret_7_7__right_activate_evolves
idris.note: Right-activation by a fact creates only matches holding it.

idris.name: iret_7_7__right_retract_evolves
idris.note: Right-retraction of a fact ends only matches holding it.

idris.name: iret_7_7__wave_evolves
idris.note: Left-activation creates the activations of what the chain passes, and ends none.

idris.name: Iret_7_7__consistent
idris.note: THE CONSISTENCY RELATION, per chain suffix relative to the front it receives and the alpha memories as they stand: each node's left memory is that front, distinct; a NOT node's counts are its blockers; the terminal holds exactly what the last node passes, distinct. Stated node by node so that each propagation path is proved one node at a time.

idris.name: iret_7_7__concat_map_append
idris.note: Concat-map distributes over append.

idris.name: iret_7_7__consistent_same_set
idris.note: Consistency is about the front as a set.

idris.name: iret_7_7__distinct_extend
idris.note: Extending a distinct front over a distinct memory is distinct: extension is injective.

idris.name: iret_7_7__elem_concat_inv
idris.note: A member of the concat-map is a member of some image.

idris.name: iret_7_7__extend_elem_fwd
idris.note: A front token plus a joining fact of the memory is in the extended front.

idris.name: iret_7_7__extend_elem_inv
idris.note: A member of an extended front is a front token plus a joining fact of the memory.

idris.name: iret_7_7__filter_append
idris.note: Filter distributes over append.

idris.name: iret_7_7__next_append
idris.note: What a node passes on distributes over append of the front.

idris.name: iret_7_7__next_disjoint
idris.note: What a node passes on from disjoint fronts is disjoint.

idris.name: iret_7_7__next_distinct
idris.note: What a node passes on from a distinct front over a distinct memory is distinct.

idris.name: iret_7_7__next_same_set
idris.note: What a node passes on is a function of the front as a set.

idris.name: iret_7_7__store_count
idris.note: A NOT node's counts after storing arrivals are the recorded ones.

idris.name: iret_7_7__wave_consistent
idris.note: LEFT-ACTIVATION KEEPS THE VIEW: a chain consistent with its front, given new arrivals not among it, is consistent with the front plus the arrivals after the wave -- every node stored them, every NOT node counted them, the terminal gained exactly the matches they complete.

idris.name: iret_7_8__unwave_consistent
idris.note: LEFT-RETRACTION KEEPS THE VIEW: when tokens of the front leave, every node drops them and their counts and the terminal loses exactly the matches they completed.
